host_activity.gpu_name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU

interpretation: PnP confirms the THM0 ACPI zone and a separate Lenovo thermal-management device, but they have different PnP parents/location paths; no evidence maps the zone to CPU package, GPU, or chassis. Prior sampler readings ranged 82.05C to 95.05C, all with passive limit 100 and throttle reason 0. This point-in-time sample does not prove sustained thermal behavior or acceptable component temperature.
source: Windows Get-Counter/Get-PnpDeviceProperty and NVIDIA nvidia-smi; read-only host diagnostics
